ctr.empty: No contracts in this status. Agree on terms in a 1:1 chat, then start with “Request a contract”.

ctr.nudgeSent: You already sent a reminder today.

ctrD.title: Contract · Signing
ctrD.sub: Standard contract, Articles 1–8. Clauses cannot be changed; you only fill in the blanks.
ctrD.none: There is no contract. Request a contract in a 1:1 chat first.
ctrD.subDone: This contract is completed. You can view it but not change it — to change it, cancel it and make a new one.
ctrD.subRich: Standard contract, Articles 1–8. Clauses cannot be changed; you only fill in the blanks.
ctrD.warnFixed: The clauses of this template cannot be changed. Only fill in the blanks below — if we edited clauses individually, we would be handling legal affairs, which is prohibited by Article 109 of the Attorney-at-Law Act.
ctrD.a1Note:
The details you registered at sign-up are filled in automatically. They cannot be changed in the contract — to change them, update your member details and issue the contract again.

Business details are filled in only after business verification. Only the last 4 digits of the phone number are shown, and the last 3 digits of the business registration number are masked.
ctrD.payWhenV: After the deal is confirmed — paid directly between the parties
ctrD.a3Note:
The referral fee is set by agreement between the parties, not by a rate table (A-12).

Pay it directly between the parties — do not send it to a SogaeBank account. We take nothing from it (INV-9 · INV-11).
ctrD.a4: Article 4 (SogaeBank is not a party to this contract)
ctrD.a4Note:
This clause cannot be changed.



① This contract is a contract between the parties. SogaeBank is not a party to it.

② SogaeBank is not responsible for the performance or non-performance of the contract.

③ SogaeBank only connects the two sides so they can find each other, and keeps a record of it.
ctrD.doneV: When both sides confirm separately — one side alone cannot confirm
ctrD.dupV: Credited to the referrer who made contact first
ctrD.a7Note:
Signatures are handled by an external e-contract service. It verifies identity by email or phone and certifies the time of signing — a timestamp we made ourselves would be weak in a dispute.

The service keeps the original; we keep only the status and a link.
ctrD.a7Warn: The integration is not live yet, so no real signature request is sent. What you see is for checking the flow only and has no legal effect.
ctrD.histNote: This is the evidence of “who did what and when” in a dispute. It cannot be deleted.
ctrD.finalWarn: Terms cannot be changed after signing. To change them, terminate and sign a new contract.

stl.title: Settlement · Get your referral fee
stl.sub: Identity-verified members receive referral fees. Only confirmed deals can be claimed (INV-3), and nothing is deducted from the fee (INV-9).
stl.needIdTitle: Verify your identity to receive referral fees
stl.needIdDesc: Individual members can receive fees too. Business verification is needed only to receive fees as a business (with a tax invoice).
stl.off: The referral fee feature is not open yet — our team will open it after identity and account verification are integrated. Until then, no settlement is created even when a deal closes.
stl.biz: You receive fees as a business — business verified {d}. Nothing is deducted; you receive the full referral fee. The referrer issues the tax invoice directly.
stl.person: You receive fees as an individual — when you claim a settlement we verify a payout account in your own name. With business verification you receive fees as a business (Switch to business). The referral fee is paid directly by the deal parties — SogaeBank does not receive or send fees on their behalf.
stl.noRetro: Referral fees for deals closed before business verification are received as an individual. The verification time is the reference date for eligibility and is not applied retroactively — for those deals, verify your payout account and then press “Get referral fee”.
stl.tax: Tax — the referral fee is the recipient’s income, so the recipient files the tax return. SogaeBank does not pay the fee and therefore does not withhold tax.
stl.dueEmpty: Nothing to claim. A settlement is created automatically when a deal is confirmed; only deals left out because account verification came late appear here.
stl.feeRow: Referral fee amount agreed by both sides (A-12)
stl.noAcc: No account registered — tell the other party directly (SogaeBank does not transfer money)
stl.flow: A claimed settlement goes from Awaiting approval → Approved · awaiting payment once our team checks the statement → Mark as received (paid) when you receive the fee. “Mark as received” appears only for approved items.

intro.codeNote: The referral code is issued the moment a 1:1 chat starts. If you proceed only by phone or KakaoTalk, there is no way to prove who the referrer is, so you cannot receive the referral fee. Always connect through the invite link. Referral credit lasts 90 days from the first contact. The full referral fee goes to the referrer — the platform takes nothing.

act.title: Activity
act.sub: Your referral activity and earned points. Points can be used after a valid connection is confirmed.
act.pointNote: Points earned only by writing a profile or sending invites cannot be used right away. They unlock once a real consultation is confirmed — this prevents fake accounts.
act.gradeNote: Your grade depends on acceptance rate and satisfaction, not on how many you send. Sending only to people you know is better for your grade.
act.mlmNote: There is no reward for bringing in members. You earn once when the person you invited completes their first referral, and nothing from their later activity — it is designed this way to prevent multi-level marketing.
